summary: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas S.A. (United Breweries Company, Inc.) furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, with comparatives to December 31, 2025. No transactional event is disclosed in the excerpt: filing covers statements of financial position, income, comprehensive income, changes in equity and cash flows plus notes on segments, financial instruments and contingencies. Only incidental mention of disposal groups held for sale appears. This is a routine periodic reporting filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisors named.
